home: Mayer & Clifton Partners, Inc. is a boutique real estate investment bank specializing in structured debt and equity advisory. Since 1991, we have successfully closed over $12 billion in transactions for privately held developers, institutional investors, and family offices. Our work is grounded in a deep understanding of capital markets, and long-standing client relationships. These relationships aren’t built on a single transaction; they are multi-decade partnerships rooted in integrity, goodwill, and competence.
company: Mayer & Clifton Partners, Inc. is a boutique real estate investment bank dedicated to structuring and securing tailored debt and equity financing solutions for real estate investors, developers, and operators. We believe that good business is built upon integrity, good will, and competence—values that have guided us over the last three decades.

Mayer & Clifton Partners was founded in 1991 by Scott Mayer & Jim Clifton after the pair realized a unique niche to provide capital to high-quality borrowers during the early 1990’s recession while most lenders were sidelined with the financial workouts of the Resolution Trust Company.

This strategy proved successful, and by the mid 1990’s the firm had become the primary boutique investment bank for Joe Benvenuti, Mort Friedman, Buzz Oates, and Jim Griggs. Over the next fifteen years, Mayer & Clifton Partners financed $12B for these clients, among others, who collectively shaped the Sacramento region with the development of hundreds of millions of square feet of real estate.

In 2018, Jim retired and took on an advisory role at the firm, marking a transition period. Over the next several years, Mayer & Clifton Partners took on a more active role in development ventures while maintaining their core investment banking services. It became clear that the firm’s greatest strength lay in creatively structuring and securing capital for its clients.

During this time, Scott deepened his philanthropic efforts, particularly through student mentorship and education, where he first met Michael Accinelli and Lauren Liebert while speaking at the University of Oregon’s Real Estate Investment Group.

After graduating, Michael and Lauren joined the acquisitions team at ScanlanKemperBard Companies, an institutional developer, while independently assembling a portfolio of nearly 100 apartment units throughout Oregon with a pool of private investors. During this time, they stayed in close contact with Scott, who continued to serve as a mentor as they navigated their ventures.

As Mayer & Clifton Partners made the strategic decision to return to its roots as a boutique investment bank, the timing aligned for Michael and Lauren to join the firm in 2024. With their unique background and fresh perspectives, they became an integral part of the firm's next chapter. Today, Mayer & Clifton Partners benefits from the combined perspective of advisors who are also active owners, bringing practical experience across operations, construction, and asset management to each assignment.

Mayer & Clifton Partners remains dedicated to delivering best-in-class debt and equity advisory services to investors, developers, and operators shaping the built environment. With a renewed focus on its core strengths and a leadership team that blends deep experience with dynamic new talent, the firm is poised for continued success.

team.name: Scott Mayer
bio: Scott Mayer began his real estate lending career in 1981 as a construction lender trainee with Lloyd’s Bank California, working first in Sacramento and later in the San Francisco Bay Area. Through the Lloyd’s training program, he developed expertise in loan origination, credit analysis, underwriting, and documentation. Scott advanced from a loan officer trainee to Regional Vice President, opening new lending offices for the bank in Marin and Walnut Creek and establishing himself as a top producer.

From 1986 to 1991, Scott served as the senior finance officer at the Sacramento office of Norris, Beggs & Simpson, a boutique real estate brokerage. In addition to managing the personnel of the office, he was responsible for loan and joint venture originations, underwriting, packaging, due diligence, closings, and portfolio management. During his tenure, the team arranged more than $500 million in joint venture equity placements and nearly $2 billion in debt transactions.

In 1991, recognizing the need for a more client-focused and institutionally disciplined platform, Scott co-founded Mayer & Clifton Partners. The firm was built to deliver customized capital solutions with an emphasis on transparency, professionalism, and long-term relationships. Over the past three decades, Mayer & Clifton has advised a broad range of institutional lenders, private capital providers, and real estate developers across the Western United States.

Scott’s client relationships have included institutional lenders such as AEGON, PGIM, Northwestern Mutual, New York Life, TIAA, AEW, and Manulife, as well as prominent developers including Fulcrum Properties, SEA Properties, SKK, Panattoni Development, and Buzz Oates. He has been active in the Mortgage Bankers Association, Bay Area Mortgage Bankers Association, and serves as a director on several nonprofit boards. He holds a B.S. in Rhetoric and Communications from the University of Oregon.

team.name: Michael Accinelli
bio: Michael joined Mayer & Clifton Partners in 2024 as an Associate Principal.

Prior to joining Mayer & Clifton Partners, Michael was a member of the acquisitions team at ScanlanKemperBard Companies (SKB), an institutional investment and development firm focused on value-add and opportunistic real estate strategies. At SKB, he was involved in the sourcing, underwriting, structuring, and execution of acquisitions, refinancings, and development projects across major West Coast markets. His experience included work on a range of property types, including office, industrial, retail, life science, and multifamily assets, and spanned the full spectrum of investment strategies from core-plus acquisitions to ground-up developments.

Michael’s real estate career began as a sophomore in college, where he worked closely with a local developer to acquire, reposition, and manage multifamily and mixed-use properties near the University of Oregon. In this highly entrepreneurial environment, he took on responsibilities across project sourcing, underwriting, business planning, construction oversight, and leasing. As his role expanded, he joined as a partner in two redevelopment projects completed during his time there.

Michael’s background combines entrepreneurial, hands-on experience with institutional investment training, informing a disciplined, pragmatic approach to real estate advisory across capital markets, operations, and asset management.

He graduated with honors from the University of Oregon with a dual B.S. in Economics and Business Administration. While at Oregon, he served as President of the university’s Real Estate Investment Group. A Sacramento native and graduate of Jesuit High School, Michael spends his free time exploring Northern California and is an avid skier, runner, and amateur pilot.

team.name: Lauren Liebert
bio: Lauren previously worked on the acquisitions team at SKB where she concentrated on hospitality and development projects while gaining experience across office, industrial, and mixed-use assets. Lauren directly oversaw the acquisition of a boutique hotel development site in Oregon’s wine country and was closely involved in the refinance of a 450,000-square-foot mixed-use project in central Denver.

Earlier in her career, Lauren worked in London at a boutique development firm specializing in the repositioning of high-end office, retail, and residential assets in central London. In this role, she was involved across the full project life cycle, including acquisitions, underwriting, project management, and leasing.

Lauren graduated with honors from the University of Oregon with a B.S. in Business Administration. While at Oregon, she was a member of the university’s Real Estate Investment Group, where she first met Michael. A native of Portland, Lauren relocated to Sacramento in 2024 and enjoys exploring Northern California’s food scene, hiking, and other outdoor activities in her free time.

servicesIntro: Mayer & Clifton Partners advises developers, institutional investors, and private real estate owners on debt placement, equity capitalization, and structured transactions across all property types. We deliver tailored capital solutions with an approach that specializes in understanding the needs of each transaction and marrying it to the specific demands of today’s evolving capital markets, where precision and alignment are critical to execution.

services.title: Debt Advisory
services.body: We advise clients on the structuring and placement of senior and subordinate debt across stabilized, value-add, development, and transitional assets. Our experience spans permanent financing for core assets, construction loans for ground-up development, bridge and mezzanine capital for transitional business plans, and agency execution for multifamily properties. We work with a full spectrum of capital providers including banks, life insurance companies, CMBS lenders, debt funds, and agency lenders to optimize proceeds, flexibility, and pricing relative to the asset's business plan.
capabilities: Agency Financing (Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, HUD)

services.title: Equity Advisory
services.body: We assist clients in sourcing and structuring equity capital to support acquisitions, developments, and recapitalizations across all major property types. Our equity assignments include joint venture structuring between sponsors and institutional partners, preferred equity placement to optimize capital stacks, and recapitalizations of stabilized or transitional assets. We work closely with private equity firms, family offices, institutional investors, and pension fund advisors, tailoring structures to align investment goals, promote arrangements, and asset-level strategies.

services.title: Separate Account Advisory
services.body: We advise family offices, and private capital sources on the formation, structuring, and execution of customized separate account real estate investment programs. Our services include identifying and sourcing acquisitions, underwriting potential platforms, asset management, and assisting in portfolio construction aligned with the investor’s return objectives, asset preferences, and risk parameters. Separate account structures allow for full ownership, enhanced control, and tailored investment strategies across core and value-add profiles.

services.title: Structured Capital Solutions
services.body: We advise on complex and non-traditional real estate capital transactions that require specialized expertise beyond conventional senior debt and common equity. Our work includes arranging financing secured by investment-grade credit tenancy, monetizing ground lease positions, advising on the sale or restructuring of real estate-secured loans, and sourcing capital for assets that are in lease-up, repositioning, or distressed conditions. Assignments often involve hospitality, office, industrial, retail, and mixed-use properties, with an emphasis on custom structures tailored to the unique characteristics of each transaction.
